pairs: Et mandavit ei (haud dubium quin esset Mardochæus) ut ingrederetur ad regem,
And he entrusted her (there was no question but that it was Mordecai) to go in to the king,
et rogaret pro populo suo et pro patria sua.
and to petition on behalf of her people and her native land.
quomodo nutrita sis in manu mea,
how you were nurtured as if in my hand,
quia Aman secundus a rege locutus est contra nos in mortem:
because Haman, who is second after the king, has spoken against us to death.
And you must call upon the Lord,
and speak with the king on our behalf,
Die autem tertio deposuit vestimenta ornatus sui,
So, on the third day, she put away her ornate apparel,
And when she was shining in a royal manner,
the Guide and Savior of all,
she took two maids with her.
And she was leaning upon one of them, as if,
quasi præ deliciis et nimia teneritudine corpus suum ferre non sustinens:
out of delicateness and great tenderness, she were not able to bear carrying her own body.
And the other maid followed her lady,
carrying her garment flowing on the ground.
Ipsa autem roseo colore vultum perfusa,
Yet she had a rosy color pouring over her face,
she restrained a sorrowful soul and very great fear.
Ingressa igitur cuncta per ordinem ostia,
entering hesitantly through a series of doors,
ubi ille residebat super solium regni sui,
where he sat upon his royal throne,
and shining with gold and precious stones.
And he was terrible to behold.
And when he had lifted up his face,
et ardentibus oculis furorem pectoris indicasset,
and with burning eyes had shown the fury of his heart,
and she rested her exhausted head upon her handmaid.
Convertitque Deus spiritum regis in mansuetudinem,
And God changed the king’s spirit into gentleness;
et sustentans eam ulnis suis donec rediret ad se,
and lifting her up in his arms until she came to herself,
he coaxed her with these words:
For this law has not been established for you,
sed pro omnibus hæc lex constituta est.
and placed it on her neck,
“Why do you not speak to me?”
et conturbatum est cor meum præ timore gloriæ tuæ.
and my heart was disturbed for fear of your glory.
Valde enim mirabilis es, domine, et facies tua plena est gratiarum.
For you, my lord, are great and wonderful, and your face is full of grace.”
because she was out of breath.
et omnes ministri ejus consolabantur eam.
and all his servants consoled her.
